mapper.select: SELECT o.id AS id, o.relation_label AS name FROM gift_person_relation_option_t o WHERE o.user_id = 0 AND o.option_type = 'SYSTEM' AND o.is_delete = 0 ORDER BY o.sort_order ASC, o.relation_code ASC

SELECT o.id AS id, o.option_type AS optionType, o.relation_code AS relationCode, o.relation_label AS relationLabel FROM gift_person_relation_option_t o WHERE o.is_delete = 0 AND ( (o.option_type = 'SYSTEM' AND o.user_id = 0) OR (o.option_type = 'CUSTOM' AND o.user_id = #{userId}) ) ORDER BY CASE o.option_type WHEN 'SYSTEM' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, o.sort_order ASC, o.last_used_time DESC, o.relation_label ASC

SELECT o.id FROM gift_person_relation_option_t o WHERE o.is_delete = 0 AND ( (o.option_type = 'SYSTEM' AND o.user_id = 0 AND o.relation_code = #{relationType}) OR (o.option_type = 'CUSTOM' AND o.user_id = #{userId} AND o.relation_label = #{relationType}) ) ORDER BY o.last_used_time DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM gift_person_relation_option_t o WHERE o.user_id = 0 AND o.option_type = 'SYSTEM' AND o.relation_code = #{relationCode} AND o.is_delete = 0
